purpose: Confirm that profile=true adds query and collector timing data which the gateway must not silently omit or mislabel as Qdrant execution
environment: Separate ephemeral single-node containers with security disabled
reproduction: Start each recorded image as an isolated single-node container with its security plugin disabled and a 512 MiB JVM heap.
Create profile-probe with title mapped as text and category mapped as keyword.
Bulk index the three recorded documents with refresh=true.
POST profile-probe/_search with the recorded request and inspect the top-level profile.shards searches, query breakdown, and collectors.
Repeat the same request without profile and count the compact HTTP response body bytes for the recorded payload observation.
limitations: This is request and response compatibility evidence, not a latency, CPU, allocation, or throughput benchmark.
Response byte counts are single compact JSON bodies from this corpus and are not representative sizing estimates.

The one-shard, three-document corpus verifies the profiling contract and an observed engine divergence; it does not characterize every query, aggregation, collector, plugin, shard layout, or engine version.
The collector names and response sizes are observations for Elasticsearch 8.15.0 and OpenSearch 3.9.0 only and should not be generalized to other versions.
